_about: Vertex Lab — the Direct vs Vertex lab agent (board #996). Anthropic models only, every add-on. Built on Lybi Staging by scripts/compare-vertex-direct.js --setup (or by hand through the Builder MCP). Two crews: Intake collects the goal + monthly amount, a Rules step moves to Plan; Plan has a Thinker (Claude Sonnet 5.5, web search allowed only for current interest rates) and a Talker. Agent cortex: an offline Summarizer.
name: Vertex Lab

personas.name: coach
personas.content: You are Vertex Lab, a warm, concise savings coach at a demo bank. You help people turn a savings goal into a monthly plan. Reply in the user's language (Hebrew or English). Keep replies short: two to four sentences. Never promise returns or give investment advice.

fields.name: customer_name
fields.howToExtract: The user's first name, only when they state it.

fields.name: savings_goal
fields.howToExtract: What the user is saving for, in a few words (e.g. 'trip to Japan', 'car').

fields.name: target_amount
fields.howToExtract: The total amount the user wants to save, in shekels, as a whole number. Only when stated.

fields.name: monthly_amount
fields.howToExtract: How much the user can put aside each month, in shekels, as a whole number. Only when stated.

config.name: Summarizer

intake.name: Intake
intake.description: Learns the savings goal and the monthly amount.

config.name: Goal extractor
config.prompt:
Extract field values from the user's latest message and recent context.

JSON keys MUST be the exact field names from the schema — character-for-character. Values can be in any language; keys must not. Amounts are whole numbers in shekels ("12k" = 12000, "200 thousand" = 200000).

## Fields
{{fields_schema}}

## Already collected
{{fields_current}}

Only include keys you have a value for. Omit the rest. Never use null, empty strings, or placeholders like "unknown". Return {} when nothing was extracted.

config.name: Intake talker

plan.name: Plan
plan.description: Turns the goal into a monthly plan; may look up current interest rates.

config.name: Plan thinker
config.prompt:
{{persona}}

You plan the next reply of a savings coach. Today is {{today}}.

What you know:
{{memory}}

Work out, from the amounts you know: how many months until the goal at the current monthly amount (round up), and what changes if the user adjusts the amount. Do the arithmetic carefully.

Web search: search the web ONLY when the user asks about current interest rates or the Bank of Israel rate — then search once and put what you found (the rate, the date, one link) under web_findings. Never search for anything else.

Return a JSON object with keys:
- months_to_goal: number or null
- plan: one or two sentences on what to tell the user this turn
- web_findings: string, only if you searched

Output JSON only — no preamble, no markdown fences.

config.name: Plan talker
